alex_cust: I'm blocked creating a new project in the console — 403 Permission denied. I'm an org admin. Happened after we updated SSO metadata earlier today. Request id: rq_0a1b2c3d
maria_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact error from the browser/network and the request id? Also which org and your display name there?
alex_cust: Error: 403 Forbidden. body: {"error":"permission_denied","message":"You do not have permission to create projects"} RequestID=rq_0a1b2c3d Org: acme-corp user: alex@acme.com
maria_support: Thanks. Can you confirm your role via the admin SCIM export? In the meantime I'll run a quick check on our side.
alex_cust: SCIM shows role: "org_admin" and groups include "acme-admins". I can edit org settings but can't create project.
maria_support: Hm. Reproduced a similar symptom internally this morning when org metadata changed. Escalating to eng. tagging @jonathan-eng @shaun-sre
jonathan-eng: Looking. Can you share the request id and the trace id from headers? Also did you try incognito or another browser? We want to rule out stale cookie.
alex_cust: Trace header: x-trace-id=tr_9f8e7d6c. Tried incognito, same 403.
jonathan-eng: Running quick search for tr_9f8e7d6c — matched. I see role lookup returned 'org_admin', but project create ACL check failed with code 403 because role propagation for recent SSO metadata update was still in 'pending' queue for your org.
shaun-sre: We have a backlog in the role-propagation worker after a large SCIM metadata push at 09:12 UTC. Cache TTL didn't get invalidated on metadata change in v2 of the worker. That caused a window where newly-mapped permissions weren't visible to the console's RBAC check.
maria_support: Workaround for now: I can grant you explicit project.create on the org using the admin API; or if your IDP can re-send the SCIM delta that triggers immediate propagation. Which do you prefer?
alex_cust: Granting explicit is fine, thanks. Could you do that and confirm? Also any ETA on a fix?
maria_support: Doing grant now. API call: POST /api/orgs/acme-corp/roles/grant {"principal":"user:alex@acme.com","permission":"project.create"} -> 200 OK
maria_support: Please try again.
alex_cust: Create succeeded, thanks! :tada:
jonathan-eng: Root cause: role-propagation worker v2 didn't purge cached role sets on metadata-change event for org-level SCIM deltas. Working on patch to force immediate invalidation and to backfill any pending queue items. Patch ready, will roll canary tonight. deploy-bot: created canary release r-2026.03.17-role-propagation-fix
shaun-sre: Also increasing worker parallelism and adding instrumentation to alert on backlog > 1000. I'll follow up when canary is green and we schedule global rollout.
maria_support: Closing this ticket as workaround applied and customer confirmed. Reopen if it reoccurs.
